title: Tue 20 Oct 2026: Tech rebounds but Europe and Korea slide, UK inflation and Budget week, FCA reporting agenda
summary: Wall Street's tech rebound fails to lift Europe, with the FTSE 100 down more than one percent and South Korean shares sharply lower, while the ten year Treasury yield climbs above five point one percent. UK September inflation, the Budget, the Fed and the ECB crowd the next ten days. In regulation, the FCA's transaction reporting consultation, the Odey ruling and the deadlines ahead; in funds, active ETF launches and the Sequoia conversion. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
